tweets.text:
Finished top 8 in a 250-person limitless tourney. 

Tourney was hosted by @ZardiCharVGC and was focused on suicide prevention and is a living memorial for Nikita Vlasenko, who unfortunately took their own life. 

@ZardiCharVGC set up a donation goal going to a suicide prevention charity so if that is a topic you are passionate about, consider donating?

Perish is fun. Thank you @ddee_ssbu for pushing me to be better and recommending Ape. Beat Up Rage Fist was fun to pilot again. Really enjoyed it. 

If you want Stat Points and benchmarks, DM me. They are free but I wanna keep it semi-lowkey.
